examples.hanzi: 日本经常发生地震。
examples.pinyin: Rìběn jīngcháng fāshēng dìzhèn.
examples.english: Earthquakes often occur in Japan.

examples.hanzi: 地震发生的时候，我们要躲到桌子下面。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng de shíhou, wǒmen yào duǒ dào zhuōzi xiàmiàn.
examples.english: When an earthquake happens, we should hide under a table.

examples.hanzi: 这位年轻的画家很有才华。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng de huàjiā hěn yǒu cáihuá.
examples.english: This young painter is very talented.

examples.hanzi: 他的才华在音乐比赛中表现得很明显。
examples.pinyin: Tā de cáihuá zài yīnyuè bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn de hěn míngxiǎn.
examples.english: His talent was clearly shown in the music competition.

examples.pinyin: Chūnjié qiánhòu de jīpiào tèbié guì.
examples.english: Plane tickets around the Spring Festival are especially expensive.

examples.hanzi: 你的机票放在包里了吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de jīpiào fàng zài bāo lǐ le ma?
examples.english: Did you put your plane ticket in your bag?

examples.hanzi: 我早饭只吃了一个鸡蛋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎofàn zhǐ chī le yí gè jīdàn.
examples.english: I only had one egg for breakfast.

examples.hanzi: 别不吃早饭，对身体不好。
examples.pinyin: Bié bù chī zǎofàn, duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
examples.english: Don't skip breakfast; it's bad for your health.

examples.hanzi: 这本小说的情节很吸引人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō de qíngjié hěn xīyǐn rén.
examples.english: The plot of this novel is very engaging.

examples.hanzi: 他的行为情节严重，必须受到处罚。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xíngwéi qíngjié yánzhòng, bìxū shòudào chùfá.
examples.english: The circumstances of his behavior are serious and he must be punished.

examples.hanzi: 周末我们一起出去玩儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ chūqù wánr ba.
examples.english: Let's go out and have fun together this weekend.

examples.hanzi: 他整天玩儿手机，不好好学习。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhěng tiān wánr shǒujī, bù hǎohāo xuéxí.
examples.english: He plays with his phone all day and doesn't study properly.

examples.hanzi: 警员正在给司机开罚单。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngyuán zhèngzài gěi sījī kāi fádān.
examples.english: The police officer is giving the driver a ticket.

examples.hanzi: 这个派出所有二十多名警员。
examples.pinyin: Zhège pàichūsuǒ yǒu èrshí duō míng jǐngyuán.
examples.english: This police station has more than twenty officers.

examples.hanzi: 这几年，他的想法转变了很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián, tā de xiǎngfǎ zhuǎnbiàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: In recent years his ideas have changed a lot.

examples.hanzi: 公司正从传统行业转变为科技企业。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèng cóng chuántǒng hángyè zhuǎnbiàn wéi kējì qǐyè.
examples.english: The company is shifting from a traditional industry to a tech enterprise.

examples.hanzi: 这个软件操作起来很简单。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn cāozuò qǐlái hěn jiǎndān.
examples.english: This software is simple to operate.

examples.hanzi: 他是第一次操作这种机器，有点紧张。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì dì-yī cì cāozuò zhè zhǒng jīqì, yǒudiǎn jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: It's his first time operating this kind of machine and he's a bit nervous.

examples.hanzi: 最初，我们只有三个人。
examples.pinyin: Zuìchū, wǒmen zhǐ yǒu sān gè rén.
examples.english: At first there were only three of us.

examples.hanzi: 这个故事的最初版本和现在不一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi de zuìchū bǎnběn hé xiànzài bù yíyàng.
examples.english: The original version of this story is different from the current one.

examples.hanzi: 医生说他的死因是心脏病。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā de sǐyīn shì xīnzàngbìng.
examples.english: The doctor said his cause of death was heart disease.

examples.hanzi: 这起事件的死因还不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ shìjiàn de sǐyīn hái bù qīngchu.
examples.english: The cause of death in this incident is still unclear.

examples.hanzi: 水是由氢和氧组成的。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ shì yóu qīng hé yǎng zǔchéng de.
examples.english: Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wǔ gè rén zǔchéng le yí gè xiǎozǔ.
examples.english: The five of us formed a small group.

examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn, wǒmen gèzì huíjiā le.
examples.english: After dinner, we each went home.

examples.hanzi: 每个人都有各自的想法。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu yǒu gèzì de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: Everyone has their own ideas.

examples.hanzi: 日本的武士有自己的行为准则。
examples.pinyin: Rìběn de wǔshì yǒu zìjǐ de xíngwéi zhǔnzé.
examples.english: Japanese samurai had their own code of conduct.

examples.hanzi: 古代的武士要从小练习武艺。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài de wǔshì yào cóngxiǎo liànxí wǔyì.
examples.english: Warriors in ancient times had to practice martial arts from childhood.

examples.hanzi: 这只小猫深受孩子们的喜爱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎo māo shēn shòu háizimen de xǐ'ài.
examples.english: This kitten is deeply loved by the children.

examples.hanzi: 他从小就喜爱画画。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù xǐ'ài huà huà.
examples.english: He has loved drawing since he was little.

examples.hanzi: 人体百分之七十是水。
examples.pinyin: Réntǐ bǎi fēn zhī qīshí shì shuǐ.
examples.english: Seventy percent of the human body is water.

examples.english: Too much sugar is no good for human health.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhuānxīn yìdiǎn, bié kàn shǒujī.
examples.english: Concentrate, and don't look at your phone.

examples.hanzi: 他专心地听老师讲课。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuānxīn de tīng lǎoshī jiǎngkè.
examples.english: He listens attentively to the teacher's lecture.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī píngmù liè le.
examples.english: My phone screen is cracked.

examples.hanzi: 别总盯着屏幕，对眼睛不好。
examples.pinyin: Bié zǒng dīngzhe píngmù, duì yǎnjing bù hǎo.
examples.english: Don't stare at the screen all the time; it's bad for your eyes.

examples.pinyin: Yóukèmen páiduì cānguān Gùgōng.
examples.english: Tourists queue up to visit the Forbidden City.

examples.hanzi: 欢迎你有空来参观我们的工厂。
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐ yǒu kòng lái cānguān wǒmen de gōngchǎng.
examples.english: You are welcome to visit our factory when you have time.

examples.hanzi: 杰夫是我们球队的队长。
examples.pinyin: Jiéfū shì wǒmen qiúduì de duìzhǎng.
examples.english: Jeff is the captain of our team.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ rènshi Jiéfū ma? Tā huì shuō yìdiǎn Zhōngwén.
examples.english: Do you know Jeff? He can speak a bit of Chinese.

examples.hanzi: 你的一番话让我很感动。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de yì fān huà ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: Your words really moved me.

examples.pinyin: Chūmén qián, tā zǐxì dǎban le yì fān.
examples.english: Before going out, she dressed up carefully.

examples.english: I got tickets to the concert this weekend.

examples.english: This film is about the investigation after a businessman was shot dead.

examples.hanzi: 毕业那天，我们和老师告别。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè nà tiān, wǒmen hé lǎoshī gàobié.
examples.english: On graduation day we said goodbye to our teachers.

examples.english: He decided to say farewell to the past and start anew.

examples.english: She kissed the baby's face.

examples.hanzi: 电影的最后，他们在雨中亲吻。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng de zuìhòu, tāmen zài yǔ zhōng qīnwěn.
examples.english: At the end of the film, they kiss in the rain.

examples.english: Everyone should contribute their strength to society.

examples.english: This scientist's contribution was recognized worldwide.

examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù jìnzhǐ dàxíng chēliàng tōngxíng.

examples.pinyin: Māma kǎo le yì zhī hěn dà de huǒjī.
examples.english: Mom roasted a very large turkey.

examples.pinyin: Nóngchǎng lǐ yǎngzhe jǐ zhī huǒjī.
examples.english: There are a few turkeys raised on the farm.

examples.pinyin: Tā bú tài huì hé mòshēngrén dǎjiāodao.

examples.english: Annie is my English teacher.

examples.english: How much money is left in your account?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le shèjiāo méitǐ zhànghù de mìmǎ.

examples.english: The image in this photo is a bit blurry.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngguò túxiàng jiǎnchá tā de nèizàng.
examples.english: The doctor examined his organs through imaging.

examples.english: The thief's accomplice kept watch outside.

examples.pinyin: Tā bù kěn shuō chū tónghuǒ de míngzi.
examples.english: He refused to give the name of his accomplice.

examples.pinyin: Xiāofángchē hěn kuài jiù gǎnlái le.
examples.english: The fire truck rushed over very soon.

examples.pinyin: Tā cóng wàidì gǎnlái cānjiā wǒ de hūnlǐ.
examples.english: He rushed in from another city to attend my wedding.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān zhè zhī gǔpiào de jiàgé xiàdiē le.
examples.english: The price of this stock fell today.

examples.pinyin: Tā de rénshēng jīnglì fēicháng fēngfù.
examples.english: His life experience is very rich.

examples.english: The school is finding ways to enrich students' after-class life.

examples.english: This is our family's business; don't get involved.
